	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = pb_entrepot_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_pb_entrepot_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = entrepot_district_tier_2_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = pb_entrepot_01
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = pb_entrepot_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = entrepot_district_tier_2_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = pb_entrepot_02
			aub_can_upgrade_to_pb_entrepot_03_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = entrepot_district_tier_3_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = pb_entrepot_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = pb_entrepot_03 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = entrepot_district_tier_3_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = pb_entrepot_03
			aub_can_upgrade_to_pb_entrepot_04_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = entrepot_district_tier_4_cost }
